title: EVIL betrays Naito & Los Ingobernables
summary: EVIL trades his LIJ brotherhood for Bullet Club support and a route to both of Naito’s championships. Naito must reclaim the belts from the partner who turned on him.

chapters.title: The Cup winner turns on Naito
chapters.result: EVIL defeats Okada, then attacks Naito and joins Bullet Club.
chapters.context: Winning the tournament becomes the prelude to a betrayal rather than an LIJ celebration.

chapters.title: EVIL takes both championships
chapters.result: EVIL defeats Naito for the heavyweight and Intercontinental titles.
chapters.context: Dick Togo’s involvement gives the new alliance an immediate championship payoff.

chapters.title: Naito regains the double gold
chapters.result: Naito defeats EVIL to recover both titles.
chapters.context: The outdoor main event gives Naito a measure of revenge against the former ally who took his championships.
